==Overview==
* Constructs a new [[mithril]] seat in Occursion, Zenith
* Kespoena's Nadir is a new [[mithril]] vein, [[Value_beneath_the_mountain|uncovered]] by the [[Argent Sword]]
* Passed
* Construction time was reduced from six months due to [[Value_beneath_the_mountain#Under_Kespoena's_Reach|exploits under Kespoena's Reach]]

==Date==
* Autumn 388YE

==Cost==
* Costs per opportunity
* 300 thrones in labour costs
* 10 thrones a season upkeep
* Three months to complete
